Warwick page is the WRAP thesis index for the School of Industrial and Business Studies (predecessor of Warwick Business School), 1972-1999, dissertations only. World Maritime University page is a dissertation index (Maritime Affairs); kept as program-list for the integrator to judge relevance, no placements. Grenoble cybersecurity page names three theses but is a computer-science/security institute, marked not-a-list. Institutions by host were kept for all pages.
